It does not appear naturally in most cases, and is instead spawned by the [[Breaker2]]. The only exception to this is [[Badlands II]], where it does spawn naturally on one wave. It has the lowest amount of health out of all the Breaker enemies, usually having half the amount of the [[Breaker2]], but is also the fastest of them all. Unlike its parent enemies, it does not spawn anything upon death. When first spawned by the [[Breaker2]] it is temporarily invincible to all forms of damage. The '''Breaker''' also appeared as part of the [[The Classic Event]], [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]] and [[The Takeover Event]]. The '''Breaker''' was replaced by the [[Png Bot]] in [[Headache Headquarters]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |The '''Breaker''' is a humanoid with a cyan torso and legs that have a triangle pattern design of varying sizes with the colors being light blue and dark blue, depending on which side the triangle is on. Its arms and head are made out of blue construction paper, with the front and back faces of each part being separate halves held together by small strips of tape. If spawned from the [[Breaker2]], the '''Breaker''' jumps up with its left arm pointed upwards before falling to the ground. It plays a squeaking sound and emits blue confetti particles on death. |Legacy |The '''Breaker''' has a baby blue skin color. It has a cyan torso and legs with a plaid stitch mark pattern on them. }} ==Strategy== *The '''Breaker''' can prove to quite dangerous due to its slightly high health and speed, as well as it being spawned by the [[Breaker2]]. **Fairly cheap high DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] and [[Golden Crook Boss]] are very useful. **Strong early game towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Ace Pilot]], [[Assassin]] or [[Militant]] are effective, though weaker ones like the [[Scout]] or [[Soldier]] may falter. **As these spawn in hordes, area of effect towers like the [[Demoman]], [[Rocketeer]], [[Pyromancer]] or the [[Shotgunner]] can be quite useful against them. **Later on, high DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Engineer]] can effectively kill these. *Be aware that you do not earn any cash from damaging the '''Breaker''' in any mode, as it does not appear naturally. *The [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be used to slow down the '''Breaker''' while also dealing decent damage to it. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! LegacyBreakerIconIG.png|Legacy '''Breaker''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Breaker's''' animation when spawning from a [[Breaker2]] is a reference to [[Mariowiki:Mario|Mario]] from the ''Super Mario Bros'' franchise. *The '''Breaker''' has the most gamemode appearances, appearing in twelve gamemodes total, alongside the [[Breaker2]], [[Breaker3]], [[Breaker4]] and [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]. *The functionality of this enemy is very similar to the [[Solar Shard]], [[Lunar Shard]] and [[Dust]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. *The appearance of this enemy is similar to the [[Super Mystery]]. *Unlike the other Breaker enemies, this enemy has a sprinting animation as opposed to a standard walking one. *There was a bug where units would instantly be destroyed upon collision with a freshly spawned '''Breaker''', regardless of the unit's or the enemy's health. **This was due to an oversight where the '''Breaker''', when spawned from the [[Breaker2]], gained a fraction of a second of invulnerability upon being spawned, instantly killing the unit without taking any damage itself. **Since [[v1.17.0]], units no longer take damage from invulnerable enemies. *The legacy '''Breaker''', along the [[Breaker2]], [[Breaker3]] and [[Breaker4]], will turn into a opaque recolored version of itself when turned into a unit by the [[Hacker]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''30 September 2022''' -
